newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weaker as demand wanes, Skikda reopens.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weaker as demand wanes, Skikda reopens.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker on Thursday as an aggressive bidder in the physical market covered his requirement and Algeria's Skikda oil port reopened after a closure of more than a week.

A trader looking for a prompt open-spec cargo picked up a Bombay cargo in exchange for an Alex cargo loading later in the month. This cargo was already nominated to a major petchem end-user but was set to remain on offer, and would quickly become distressed, traders said.
Swaps slipped some $5, with Dec trading at $212 and $211.
